abstract: Human germinal tumor cells have been studied in cancer research because of their characteristics of the multi-potentiality and the ability to produce marker proteins such as AFP and SP1. Although human germinal tumor cell colonies had usually been maintained by serial transplantation into nude mice, we established in vitro culture method of cells derived from human malignant germ cell tumors. Thirty-two cell lines were established in vitro, and AFP and SP1 produced in culture medium of those cell line were demonstrated immunochemically.
abstract_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞は、多分化能を有し、AFPやSP1などのマーカータンパクを産生する特性から、癌研究で扱われてきた。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の細胞コロニーは通常、ヌードマウスへの継代移植により維持されてきたが、われわれはヒト悪性胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞のin vitro培養法を確立した。32株の細胞株をin vitroで樹立し、それらの培養上清中に産生されたAFPおよびSP1を免疫化学的に証明した。
